correctness.rationale: PASS: At the frozen Git RESULT.md blob c36009f..., the claim is for one labelled ^5 14^3_8 simplicial S^4×S^1 and simple edge cycles, not arbitrary metrics. Read the complete Git verify.py facet table and unimodular reduction: the 84-edge graph has 13 spanning-tree edges and a rank-71 graph-cycle lattice; 210 facial triangle relations reduce by integer unit pivots to an identity block rank 70 plus zero column, hence H1(Z)=Z without torsion. Explicit integral 1-cocycle annihilates all facial relations and takes +1 on each of the 70 nonfacial oriented 3-cycles. All graph cliques enumerated as 280 with 210 facial, so no shorter graph cycles (girth of a simple cycle >=3), and exactly 70 primitive integral systolic 3-cycles. Shift/reflection checked on full facet set, with 5 translation orbits of 14 and dihedral carrier orbits 14,28,14,14; transported generator action +1/-1. Independently reproduced with a separate finite combinatorial calculation from seven missing antipodal edges and the sparse cocycle: 280 graph triangles with cocycle value 0 for 210 and +1 for 70, and the stated 5/4 orbit sizes. The finite combinatorial census is exhaustive for THIS 14-vertex complex, but no claim of an all-triangulations proof is made. The supplied verification script was inspected rather than executed end-to-end; integer rank computation is reasoned from its explicit unit operations, not accepted from VERIFY_OK alone.
